dct_description_sm: # Grenada St Vincent and the Grenadines Hurricane Beryl: Damage Proxy Maps, Jul 2024 The **Earth Observatory of Singapore – Remote Sensing Lab (EOS-RS)** produced these damage proxy maps for Grenada St Vincent and the Grenadines Hurricane Beryl (Jul 2024) from synthetic aperture radar (SAR) satellite images.
